problems_addressed.specific_problem: Will AI replace real estate agents?
problems_addressed.solution_summary: AI will not replace agents but will replace average marketing. Agents should focus on becoming trusted advisors and leveraging AI for better branding.

problems_addressed.solution_summary: Agents should focus on building a strong personal brand and becoming small media companies to provide valuable content and expertise.

episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the transformative impact of AI on the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle matching over traditional metrics like square footage. She highlights the need for agents to focus on personal branding and becoming trusted advisors in an AI-driven world. With insights into Chicago's unique position in the luxury market, this episode offers valuable strategies for agents looking to thrive in a rapidly evolving industry.
